implementation: Extracted S41 into ChatDetailScreen.tsx with one useChatDetailController and retained the existing thin route and return intent.
Keyed booking and message state by booking plus actor, reused subscribeToBooking, and refreshed canonical booking and message reads on focus and foreground resume.

Added loading/ready/error/retry chat phases, id-based realtime/snapshot reconciliation sorted by created_at then id, and canonical readback after send while preserving the RPC nudge and failed-send draft.
Restricted read-state initialization and heartbeat writes to a loaded current chat; kept the opened-read timestamp and unread divider fixed across reloads.
Kept the original four-status closed predicate and unchanged server RPC enforcement; made no migration, registration, or shared API edits.

acceptance.evidence: Subscription readback removed the composer for cancelled, declined, expired and pending_payment. The direct-send rejection path remains the existing server RPC guard.
A successful send performs a canonical listMessages readback and reconciles the accepted row once without a subscription event.
A delayed initial snapshot merged with an intervening subscription event by message ID and sorted by created_at then ID.
An initial list failure stays in error phase with Retry; it does not produce an empty-chat greeting.
completed, closed and closed_no_work retain the pre-existing composer behavior; only the original four statuses are closed in the UI.
The divider remains anchored to the first unread message from the opening read snapshot after later messages arrive.
Switching booking or actor immediately presents a loading/null state instead of prior chat rows.

red.summary: Before behavior changes, the screen retained the mount-time booking state and did not distinguish an initial message-read error from an empty list. A focus-effect test mock issue was corrected before the green run.
